title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: HubSpot
providers.scope_notes: Private-app and newer developer-platform static authentication coexist. SSO requires eligible Professional/Enterprise subscriptions.

controls.name: User permission: Developer tools access
controls.what: Controls which non-Super Admin users can access developer features; creating service keys requires it.
controls.setting: Settings > Users & Teams > user > permissions (Settings access)
controls.quote: Developer tools access : toggle the Developer tools access switch on to let the user access and manage developer features

controls.name: Developer API key deactivate/regenerate
controls.what: The single per-account developer API key can be deactivated and replaced at any time.
controls.quote: You can deactivate your API key and generate a new one at any time.

controls_unknown: No IP allowlist for API calls found; "Allowed login IPs" (Settings > Security > Login) is documented only for logins.
Whether app governance (approval) covers privately distributed OAuth apps and static-auth apps, or only HubSpot Marketplace listings.
No admin-set token lifetime or mandatory rotation policy found for private app tokens, static tokens, service keys or the developer API key (only manual rotation and reminders).
No account-wide switch found to block service key creation other than withholding Developer tools access / Super Admin.

authentication.summary: Account-level key passed as the hapikey query parameter, usually with appId, for app features and settings that require it (for example the custom channels API). It is not a general CRM data credential.

federation.details: Static account key; no external identity exchange is documented.

ip_restriction.boundary: HubSpot's trusted-IP setting limits account logins. Its effect on calls made with a developer API key is not documented.

renewal.summary: The key is reused until deactivated; deactivate it and generate a new one to rotate.

administration.summary: Managed under Development > Keys > Developer API key. One key per HubSpot account, not per user; it can be deactivated and regenerated at any time.
administration.conditions: Still documented in current developer-platform docs; no current deprecation notice found. Separate from the account API keys (hapikey) sunset in 2022.

offboard.details: The developer API key belongs to the account, not to a user.

inventory.details: Only one key per account; it is shown at Development > Keys > Developer API key.

token_format.notes: Account-level developer API key passed as hapikey query parameter (often with appId). One key per account. Format not documented in fetched docs. GitHub scans a 'Hubspot API Key' type; whether it matches developer keys is unconfirmed.

log_sources.name: None documented for developer API key use
log_sources.notes: Fetched docs list no call log or audit events for developer API keys.

anomaly_cues: hapikey appearing in proxy/web server logs, referrers or URL-capturing tools (query-string credential)
Unexpected changes to app features that require the key (e.g., custom channels registrations) for an appId
Key not rotated after a developer leaves

containment.steps: Development > Keys > Developer API key: deactivate the key and generate a new one.
containment.notes: Docs say the key can be deactivated at any time; timing of enforcement not stated.

sample_query.query: Search own proxy/web logs for 'hapikey=' in request URLs to api.hubapi.com
sample_query.purpose: Find where the query-string key was used or leaked.

unknown: Any HubSpot log of developer API key use or rotation

evidence.title: Manage apps in HubSpot - HubSpot docs
